Road closure at CR 450 E between CR 1175 S and CR 1200 S near the Adams and Jay county line. Water continues to rise in the area.
Large tree limbs snapped onto a home by Westlea Park in Marion. Photo of the damage provided by homeowner. Time estimated via radar.
Power lines snapped at the intersection of Spencer Avenue and North Washington Street in Marion. Time estimated via radar.
Moving water_ 4 to 5 feet deep in spots_ reported on several county roads southeast of Bluffton. A few road closures and school delays due to the flooding.
Numerous roads closed. Numerous vehicles stranded. Over a dozen water rescues in and around Bluffton.
Report from mPING: Street/road flooding; Street/road closed; Vehicles stranded.

minor flooding occurring around La Porte. water covering several roads.
